capability_notes.default: Existing partial WASTE application ABI; availability and Wasm signatures do not imply full C/POSIX conformance.
capability_notes.locale: Fixed C.UTF-8 facade; setlocale ignores the requested locale/category, uselocale is a compatibility stub. No locale object lifecycle API.
capability_notes.wide_characters: Existing limited classification/conversion subset; no claim of complete Unicode classification or stateful encodings.
capability_notes.stdio: Guest-owned opaque FILE; formatting/scanning implement the existing subset, not all standard conversions.
capability_notes.filesystem: Engine-owned in-memory namespace and descriptors; adapters enforce their supported flags and errno. No host filesystem access.
capability_notes.threads: Guest mutex helpers are single-threaded compatibility stubs; pthread creation, conditions, rwlocks and TLS APIs are unavailable.
capability_notes.network: Current syscall wrappers are unsupported without a capability provider; no raw socket or DNS capability is added by headers.
capability_notes.processes: Existing browser engine fork/exec/wait model; native guest execution parity remains Stage 6. posix_spawn and vfork unavailable.
capability_notes.dynamic_loading: Existing engine-owned handles and installed Wasm DSO loader; no native host-library loading.
capability_notes.mapping: Existing engine mappings, i64 offsets and bounded permissions; MAP_FIXED unsupported. No claim of host mmap semantics.
capability_notes.ncurses: Configured pinned DSO, unsigned four-byte NCURSES_BOOL. Missing optional/debug/SP entry points are compile-time unavailable.
capability_notes.assert: Default assert uses compiler trap; no diagnostic text or SIGABRT delivery. NDEBUG omits evaluation. Legacy package abort remains unchanged.
capability_notes.signals: Engine-owned 128-bit signal sets, block/unblock/setmask and blocked-pending queries; SIGKILL/SIGSTOP cannot be blocked. Caught handlers are serviced at the existing pselect boundary, whose handler slot uses an engine function index; arbitrary compiled C function-pointer and sigaction flag conformance is not established.
